low.description: The ministry count, or the figure its source stands behind.

high.description: The widest count any source supports — the organiser/map count where one exists.

q.description: Omitted when the row is a plain published national count.

unit.description: Omitted means "actions" (the ministry's action de voie publique).

sources.description: Every Source.id the band rests on: low and high may be different publishers.

unattributed.description: Endpoints of the band whose publisher is not in `src/data/sources/`. Provenance, not quality — `q` is the quality flag. A row may carry one.

derivedFrom.description: Set when the row is a projection of an existing FACTS cell, not a new figure.

Flag.description: n = published point · r = regional only · p = partial · f = floor e = derived/modelled · c = stock or actions-total · w = weekly aggregate "x" = a wider measure than the metric's definition (perturbés, closed).

ActUnit.description: What a row counts. Rows of different units are never summed.
